name: gizza-ai/video-aspect-pad
summary: Letterbox or pillarbox a video to a target aspect ratio

tool.description: Letterbox or pillarbox a video to a target aspect ratio with colored bars — e.g. pad a landscape clip to 9:16 for Reels/Shorts/TikTok or to 1:1 for a feed post. The whole frame is kept (scaled to fit, never cropped or stretched) and centered on the target canvas; the rest is filled with the bar color. Output is exactly the platform-standard canvas for the chosen aspect (1080x1920 for 9:16, 1080x1080 for 1:1, 1920x1080 for 16:9, ...) unless width sets a custom size. Provide the video as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref. Video re-encodes as H.264 (CRF 23); audio is copied untouched. Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

aspect.description: Target aspect ratio (width:height). 9:16 Reels/Shorts/TikTok, 1:1 square feed, 16:9 YouTube, 4:5 Instagram portrait, 2:3 Pinterest, 21:9 cinematic. Default 9:16.

color.description: Bar color: a CSS color name (black, white, navy, ...) or hex like #1A2B3C. Default black.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Output width in pixels (even, 16-4096); height follows the aspect ratio. Omit for the platform-standard canvas (1080x1920 for 9:16, 1920x1080 for 16:9, ...).
